Alternative to outlook but has instant push notifications?
I've tried a few other email clients on android but I never found something better than outlook and their push notification. I'm trying to get out the Microsoft ecosystem and wanted another email client. 

But most email client their push notification when you get a new email isn't good or there's some delay. 

Has anyone tested other email client that's good has quick or instant email notification and there is a unified mailbox?
